title: Language implementation resources: semantics frameworks, verified compilers, compiler infrastructure, parsers, runtimes
description: Cross-language resources for implementing languages: executable/mechanised semantics frameworks (K, PLT Redex, Ott, Lem, Sail) and the language definitions written in them, verified compilers (CompCert, CakeML, Vellvm, WasmCert, JSCert), compiler infrastructure and tutorials (LLVM Kaleidoscope, GCC internals, MLIR, Cranelift, QBE, GraalVM Truffle, RPython), parser generators and grammar collections (tree-sitter, ANTLR, Bison, Menhir), small instructive compilers (chibicc, TCC, lcc, c4, mal), garbage collectors (MMTk, Boehm GC) and tooling protocols.
